cards.title: What makes it a registry
items: Each guard declares its own registry table at the top of its file
The test suite asserts the count of guards, so adding a file is not enough — it must be registered
A stale entry (registered but no longer present) is red too, not just a missing one

cards.title: Every guard proves itself in both directions
items: Each guard has --selftest and prints SELFTEST COUNTS {"bad": N, "good": M}
The test parses that one line and asserts a lower bound: adding cases stays green, deleting cases turns red
N and M are counted from real execution and are never hand-written

cards.title: Guard vs contract
items: MIN_GUARDS counts the guard files under tools/; check_all.py itself is not one of them
GUARD_CONTRACT tracks the wrapper, so the two numbers differ by exactly one
